reason: Chasing documents is exactly what eats my evenings, and 900 plus 50 a month is not crazy for my firm, but I am not handing my clients' files and my firm's WhatsApp name to a one-man side project with a single pilot client I cannot even call yet. I have two grants due Friday; I will not touch this before then, and after that I want proof, not a promise.
objection: The founder does this 10-12 hours a week after his day job, has one client, and the only reference becomes available after a 60-day pilot. My clients are farmers and small firms who panic near a deadline; if the link breaks on a Thursday night I am the one they call, not him, and the fallback upload form does not fix how that looks for my firm.
would_change_my_mind: A 15-minute phone call with the Bihor consultant after his 60 days, saying the chasing actually dropped and his clients used the WhatsApp link without complaints; then I would sign the next day.
